reviews.review: SCP Abhorrent is an abomination. You can tell if a game is going to be total ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ when in the first 5 minutes of the game starting, it opens with some of the worst voice acting that you have ever heard in a video game. Once the awful cutscene finishes you are instructed to find a ladder, and the game has the audacity to make everything pitch black which makes you walk slowly all over the place with your flashlight out. None of this even matters though because visuals are horrendous. This just might be the most ugly and foul game that I have ever had the displeasure of playing, Big rigs looks better than this ♥♥♥♥ and calling what you see on the models 'Textures' might be the biggest compliment I can give this game. Combat is atrocious with you only  being able to kill the enemy with a headshot and If the only way you can design a game to be difficult is to make the enemies unkillable unless you shoot them in the head then YOU DUN ♥♥♥♥♥♥ IT UP!

FLAWLESS, Had a blast all the way though. just don't take the game seriously at all

Love to see if there will be a remaster of this masterpiece
